## Two things worth knowing up front

**You have read access, and that is enough.** You will not push, branch, or open a pull
request here. Everything you do — asking, answering, submitting, being reviewed —
happens in **Discussions**. This is deliberate, not a limitation:
[why](docs/04-operations/access-control.md).

**Briefs live in two places, and one of them is canonical.** The file in
`activities/briefs/` is the source of truth; the Discussion thread is the working copy,
published from the file. If they ever disagree, the file is right — and that is a bug
worth [reporting](https://github.com/REPLACE-ME-org/batch-fde-c4/issues/new/choose).
